name: 10000 let spustya
source:
The protagonist spent so much time in "Sovenok" that he went crazy. His concepts of morality and ethics were monstrously distorted, and he himself acquired an irresistible craving for torture and brutal rape.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2784132604]Steam[/url]]
